desc: Bhinnashtakavarga (BAV) for one planet.
Get Kaksha (sub-division) level Ashtakavarga analysis — divides each sign into 8 equal 3°45′ segments, each ruled by a graha.
Get the Sarvashtakavarga table — the combined 12-sign benefic-point grid from all 9 grahas.
Score current (or a given date's) planetary transits against a natal chart using Ashtakavarga benefic points.
Find the Adhik Maas (intercalary/leap month) in a given year — the extra lunar month inserted to sync the Hindu lunar calendar with the solar year.
Get the Hindu calendar details for a Gregorian month — maps each day to its Hindu month (Chaitra/Vaishakha/…), paksha (Shukla/Krishna), tithi, and Vikram Samvat year.
Get the current Hindu Ritu (season) for a date — one of 6 seasons: Vasanta (spring), Grishma (summer), Varsha (monsoon), Sharad (autumn), Hemanta (pre-winter), Shishira (winter).
Get the Samvatsara (Jupiter year) name for a given year — the 60-year Jupiter cycle used in Hindu astrology (Prabhava, Vibhava, Shukla, … Akshaya).

Equinoxes and solstices of a year — exact moment (UTC + local), the ayana that begins (tropical Dakshinayana at the June solstice, tropical Uttarayana at the December solstice; the panchang's Uttarayana is Makara Sankranti), and with lat/lon the sunrise, sunset and day length at that place.
Ascendant (Lagna): sign, degree, nakshatra, pada and lord.

Any divisional (varga) chart, e.g. D1, D9, D10, D60.

Get the KP sublord of a planet — the sub-lord of the nakshatra sub-division the planet occupies (KP star lord → sub lord → sub-sub lord chain).

Whole birth chart as data in one call (50 credits): lagna; planets with sign, degree, house, nakshatra, pada, retrograde, combust, dignity, neecha bhanga, vargottama, houses ruled, shadbala, avastha and varga placements; houses with sign, lord, SAV bindus, bhava bala, occupants and aspecting planets; Jaimini chara karakas; avakhada. vargas: comma list (default D9, max 16, D1 rejected). include: shadbala, bhavabala, ashtakvarga, aspects, avastha, karakas, avakhada, yogas or all (default all but yogas). gender narrows Mahabhagya. Birth (Janma) nakshatra and pada.

Birth-time sensitivity (20 credits): for D1 and each varga (default D9,D10,D24) the lagna sign at birth and how many minutes before/after it stays the same, with the neighbouring signs; the same for the Moon's nakshatra and pada; planet sign changes inside the window. window: half-width in minutes (default 120, max 180). Use it to tell users how much a birth-time error matters. Every instant comes as *_local (RFC 3339 with offset) and *_jd (Julian Day, UT); fields that cannot be computed are listed in skipped.

Find Shubha Yoga (auspicious panchang yoga) windows in a date range — checks for Amrit Siddhi, Sarvartha Siddhi, Ravi Yoga, and other classical panchang yogas in combination.
Compute Tara Bala score for a given date relative to a person's birth nakshatra — rates the day's Moon nakshatra as Janma/Sampat/Vipat/Kshema/Pratyak/Sadhana/Vadha/Mitra/Param-Mitra.
Auspicious wedding (vivah) muhurta windows in a date range. Each `factors[]` item has a stable English `id` (e.g. `Tithi`, `RahuKaal`); `name` and `value` follow `lang`.

Find auspicious Yatra (travel/journey) muhurta windows — avoids Disha Shool (directional inauspiciousness), Rahu Kaal, Nak Shool, and favours Pushya/Hasta/Ashwini/Anuradha nakshatras for journeys. Each `factors[]` item has a stable English `id` (e.g. `Tithi`, `RahuKaal`); `name` and `value` follow `lang`.

Get a multi-paragraph career and profession narrative for a Vedic birth chart — analyses the 10th house lord, planets in the 10th, D10 chart, and dashas to describe career strengths, suitable professions, and current period's impact on work.

Get the Dasha Phal (period interpretation) narrative for the Vimshottari dasha running at the given moment — Mahadasha, Antardasha and Pratyantar down to the sookshma and prana levels, plus dasha-sandhi sections when a period change is near. `birth` is the natal chart; date/time/tz are the moment to read.

Get a finance and wealth narrative for a Vedic birth chart — analyses the 2nd and 11th house lords, Jupiter, Venus, and wealth yogas to describe financial strengths, challenges, and periods of prosperity.

Get a personalised daily horoscope narrative computed from the rising sign (lagna) of a birth chart — more precise than generic Moon-sign horoscopes since it uses the exact birth data. The input is the birth chart; pass `onDate` (YYYY-MM-DD) to read a day other than today.

Get a narrative interpretation of a specific house lord's placement — where the lord of house N is placed in the chart and what it means for the areas of life that house governs.
Get a comprehensive narrative overview of all 12 house lords' placements in a birth chart — a full bhavesh analysis summarising how each house lord's position shapes the chart.

Get the Jaimini Chara Karakas for a birth chart — the 8 karaka planets (Atmakaraka, Amatyakaraka, Bhratrukaraka, Matrukaraka, Putrakaraka, Gnatikaraka, Darakaraka, Dara/Swamsha) determined by planet degrees, with interpretation.

Get a narrative interpretation of the birth chart's lagna (ascendant) — describes the physical appearance, personality, health tendencies, and life approach associated with the rising sign, including first-house planets' influence.

Get a marriage and relationship narrative for a Vedic birth chart — analyses the 7th house lord, Venus, navamsa, and marriage-timing dashas to describe relationship characteristics, likely spouse traits, and timing of marriage.

Get a narrative compatibility analysis for a couple — a written reading of the Ashtakoota result (verdict and each koota; Tara and Graha Maitri are scored both ways) plus synastry sections from the graha signs of both charts.

Get a narrative interpretation of a specific planet's sign placement — describes how the planet expresses itself in that rashi, classical dignity/debility implications, and characteristic traits.
